surfaces.condition: A material feature, functionality, behavior, CLI/API, workflow, data, integration, security/privacy, or quality/release change is added or changed.
validation: Update this matrix in the same change with affected surfaces, contracts, documentation, tests, evidence, owners, and projections.
For a purely internal refactor or isolated fix with no matrix impact, record a reviewed no-impact reason in the same change record; omission is not an implicit no-impact decision.

surfaces.path: quality_runner/, quality_evidence_contract/, repo_quality_certifier/, and public documentation
surfaces.condition: scan, policy, finding, CLI, certification, or public documentation behavior changes
validation: malformed subprocess stdout/stderr decoding regression preserves bounded fleet evidence

pnpm dynamic dependency setup regressions under a compatible Node runtime: exact declared pnpm 10 lock semantics, fleet-owned pnpm 11 frozen-store behavior, prepared Corepack and metadata caches, and canonical-parent local dependency resolution
collision-safe remediation wiring ID regression for normalized path collisions

For maturity changes, verify dimension-to-capability-to-pillar aggregation, reverse producer coverage, explicit capability applicability, evidence coverage, missing capabilities, and confirmed-risk-only critical caps.

surfaces.path: installed qr, plugins, Pronto, quality-runner-fleet-scope/v1, quality-runner-maturity-feed/v2, and quality-runner-repository-maturity/v2
surfaces.condition: command, plugin, fleet scope, measurement confidence, feed schema, taxonomy, publication behavior, maturity pillar, applicability, coverage, cap, or source-dimension changes
validation: consumer contract readback in Pronto, including measurement confidence, v1 migration labeling, and v2 capability/pillar projection

surfaces.path: quality_runner/fleet/custody.py, quality_runner/cli_fleet.py, quality_runner/cli.py, quality_runner/schemas/custody-validation.schema.json, tests/test_fleet_custody.py, docs/integrations/pronto-custody.md, and Pronto custody consumer readback
surfaces.owner: Quality Runner and Pronto integration owners
surfaces.condition: Isolated-change custody state, receipt integrity classification, granular disposition taxonomy, adoption readiness, WIP safety, or read-only authority boundaries change.
validation: uv run --locked ruff check quality_runner/fleet/custody.py quality_runner/cli_fleet.py quality_runner/cli.py tests/test_fleet_custody.py
Validate the sanitized custody-validation schema and public adapter fixture.
Run qr fleet custody validate against a synthetic repository and confirm the result is read-only, granular, and consumer-readable by Pronto.

surfaces.path: .mac-control/ideal-state.json, the installed validator, and the public maturity contract
surfaces.condition: manifest schema, semantic dimension, source grounding, provider boundary, score, or disposition behavior changes

surfaces.path: qr fleet detector refresh, repository-local .quality-runner/runs, Pronto quality ingestion, and operator documentation
surfaces.owner: Quality Runner and Pronto integration owners
surfaces.condition: exact-target detector scanning, external detector adapters, pinned producer provenance, ruleset/configuration cache invalidation, overlap/deduplication, skill-pack selection, publication, status taxonomy, or consumer orchestration changes
validation: production refresh callback signature bind in the detector refresh happy-path test
explicit repository deadline propagation to inspect, run, verify, and total refresh budgets
missing phase artifact diagnostic retention and no-partial-publication regression
pinned Anti-Slop JSON/SARIF adapter provenance and compatible JavaScript/TypeScript applicability regression
target SHA, QR version, producer version, source SHA, ruleset, and configuration cache invalidation regression
blocked or malformed external detector evidence cannot publish as zero findings or erase prior valid evidence
native/external overlap relation and unchanged rerun deduplication regression
qr fleet detector refresh --repo-path FIXTURE --projects-root ROOT --json

surfaces.condition: CI, packaging, release, or distribution boundary behavior changes

surfaces.condition: a change depends on a particular workstation, private repository, account, or fleet inventory
